# brandkit

On-demand reference adapted from the vendored MIT UI/UX Kit. Project policy
and frontend-design govern scope and completion.

Use for a requested new brand/theme foundation. Establish audience, content,
and constraints, then the minimum reusable color/type/spacing roles.
Prefer an existing theme when available; use DTCG only when it fits the stack.
Check real controls/themes and retain one authoritative source. Branding does
not authorize replacing product behavior or importing absent sample apps.
